from pathlib import Path

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        if (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(grid[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and
            all(grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
            pattern = [[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pattern))
    sources = [f for f in frames if any(any(row) for row in f[5])]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pattern in frames:
        if any(any(row) for row in pattern):
            continue
        matches = [s for s in sources if (s[2]-s[1],s[4]-s[3]) == (r1-r0,c1-c0)]
        if len(matches) == 1:
            src = matches[0]
            for dr,row in enumerate(src[5],1):
                for dc,present in enumerate(row,1):
                    if present:
                        out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = color
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-1b41a760.py'; p.write_text(code)
print(p)
